headline: Acquisition lifts revenue sharply; margins and profit fall
summary_short: RLX's Q3 net revenues rose 69.7% to RMB1,916.6M after consolidating its European acquisition, but gross margin fell to 23.3% from 31.2% and GAAP net income dropped to RMB147.1M from RMB206.8M.
summary_long: International business was 86.5% of revenue. Gross profit rose 26.7% to RMB446.6M. Operating expenses jumped to RMB407.1M from RMB259.3M on salary, shipping and legal costs, taking GAAP operating income to RMB39.5M from RMB93.3M. Non-GAAP operating income was RMB143.8M versus RMB187.8M. Total financial assets were RMB13.48B. The CFO flags working-capital needs from the UK's October excise duty.
confidence_notes: Found via WebSearch (shard sourceLink was a Yahoo fallback); primary is the company's 6-K EX-99.1 on EDGAR. Prior-quarter comparisons are not in the release and are omitted.
